title: When the Salt Falls Revisited
author: Sebastian Okonkwo
blurb: Elodie Blackwood, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, has spent twenty years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
